items.title: Google puts Target and Albertsons grocery carts inside Search and Gemini
items.excerpt: Google began rolling out Connected Apps in US Search and the Gemini app for Albertsons, Safeway, Shaw's and Target: Gemini interprets a loose request, picks products and fills the retailer cart via the Universal Commerce Protocol. Experian and H&R Block also reached Search, with Angi and Thumbtack due in coming weeks.

items.title: Amazon draws 24% of retailer searches but 11% of AI shopping answers
items.excerpt: Verve data (Sep 1 - Nov 16) shows Amazon takes 24% of US retailer searches but is named in only 11% of AI shopping answers, while Target and smaller retailers are over-represented in AI answers relative to search share.

history_match.title: Ads In Google AI Answers Concentrate In Apparel & Electronics

items.title: Databricks lines up nine ad platforms for its customer-value signals
items.excerpt: Databricks unveiled CustomerLake Conversions, which sends model-predicted lifetime value and other signals to nine ad platforms so their bidding optimizes toward the most valuable conversions; Campaign Agents build audiences from natural-language prompts. No release date or pricing yet.

history_match.title: Microsoft Advertising Biggest Upgrade To Bidding Models In A Decade

items.title: Microsoft Ads In AI Overviews on Bing
items.excerpt: Microsoft confirmed on the Microsoft Advertising blog that search ads now show in Bing AI Overviews (all markets except China), alongside URL inclusions for AI Max, GA AI-content labels and an expanded MCP server.

history_match.title: Bing & Microsoft Ads With Made With AI Label

items.title: OpenAI rewrites ChatGPT Business Hub terms after legal language raises concerns
items.excerpt: OpenAI revised its ChatGPT Business Hub terms after concerns that the original language could restrict businesses' legal claims - a new action on the hub where brands manage how they appear and run sponsored agents in ChatGPT.

history_match.title: OpenAI's new business agents give brands a free way into the conversation it's also selling as an ad

items.title: Anthropic says no to ads but Wall Street may have other ideas
items.excerpt: With its IPO, an $895bn compute bill and a costly free tier, Anthropic's no-ads pledge for Claude may have a shelf life, Digiday reports, as ad buyers weigh the next assistant ad inventory.

items.title: In Graphic Detail: Welcome to the agentic commerce quarter
items.excerpt: OpenAI, Google, Amazon and Walmart are betting on agent-led holiday shopping; Modern Retail/Digiday chart adoption and conversion data showing how far agentic commerce still has to go this BFCM quarter.

history_match.title: Visa launches benchmark for AI shopping agents

items.title: Agentic Advertising in practice at Tech Lab's International Summit
items.excerpt: IAB Tech Lab recaps its London International Summit sessions on agentic advertising in practice - agent-to-agent media buying, CTV and moving ad tech server-side - and where its agentic specs stand.

history_match.title: IAB Tech Lab extends AI ad-buying standard comments to November 10

items.title: Measuring Clicks Is Making ChatGPT Ads Look Like A Bad Bet
items.excerpt: An Incrmntal op-ed argues advertisers are judging ChatGPT ads by search-style click metrics, and that conversational AI ads need incrementality measurement rather than last-click comparisons with Google.

items.title: Walmart mulls role advertising will play in an agentic shopping world
items.excerpt: On its Q3 call, Walmart said ad momentum (Walmart Connect) remains strong but executives acknowledged AI agents such as Sparky are producing different consumer behaviors, and weighed how ads will fit agent-led shopping.

history_match.title: Walmart ramps up Sparky features in time for the holidays

items.title: Portland Leather reaches new website visitors with ChatGPT Ads
items.excerpt: OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads customer story: Portland Leather tested ads reaching people researching their next bag and found many click-throughs were first-time website visitors - an official measured advertiser result.

items.title: 韓 스트리밍 이용자, 시간당 7분 광고 수용…AI광고 거부감 낮아
items.excerpt: 매그나이트 보고서에 따르면 한국 광고 지원 스트리밍 이용자의 67%가 시간당 약 7분의 광고를 수용할 수 있다고 답했고, 맞춤형·AI 기반 광고에 대한 거부감도 비교적 낮았다.

items.title: 비자, '에이전틱 레디' 프로그램 확대…매입사·PSP·PG사·가맹점과 협력
items.excerpt: 비자가 AI 에이전트가 결제하는 환경을 만들기 위해 '에이전틱 레디' 프로그램을 매입사·PSP·PG사·일부 가맹점 등 50곳 이상 참여사로 전면 확대했다. 내년 추가 파트너가 합류한다.

items.title: 구글·팔란티어 부른 올리브영…"무한 스크롤 쇼핑시대 끝낸다"
items.excerpt: CJ올리브영이 첫 테크 콘퍼런스 '디파인 옴니'에서 상품 탐색부터 장바구니까지 AI가 처리하는 에이전틱 커머스 구상과 글로벌몰 AI 쇼핑 전략을 공개했다.

items.title: 수호아이오 "AI 에이전트가 발주·결제하려면 거래 검증 인프라 필요"
items.excerpt: AI 에이전트가 가게 주인 대신 발주하고 대금을 지급하려면 재고·발주·물류·결제 서비스를 연결하고 권한 내 거래인지 검증하는 인프라가 필요하다고 수호아이오가 밝혔다.
